tree.heading: Head of Office.—
tree.text: The head of the Office of Federal Procurement Policy is the Administrator for Federal Procurement Policy.

tree.heading: Appointment.—
tree.text: The Administrator is appointed by the President, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate.
